text: Compared with the earlier promise, the difference is smaller than it seems. Isaac is the child of the covenant, the one through whom the nations are to be blessed; and it is this very promise that God turns into a test. Much depends upon a single word, _hineni_, "here I am," which Abraham speaks three times. Its meaning shifts at each speaking. It costs him more, too, every time, from his first answer to God, through his answer to Isaac, to his last answer to the angel.
